subject: Carnatic Music (Percussion Instruments)

source.title: Carnatic Music (Percussion Instruments), Code 033, Classes XI-XII (2026-27)

internalBreakdown.component: Internal assessment: project file 5, project work 5, periodic practical tests 10

notes: Theory 30 marks (2 hours) without a unit-wise split; practical 50 (external examiner); internal assessment 20.

units.name: Theory: History and Theory of Indian Music

chapters.name: Lakshana Granthas (Class XII)
topics: Chaturdandi Prakashika, Sangita Ratnakara, Ragavibodha, Svaramela Kalanidhi with reference to tala and percussion

chapters.name: Percussion Luminaries (Class XII)
topics: Needamangalam Meenakshi Sundaram Pillai, Tanjore Vaidyanatha Iyer, Palghat Mani Iyer, Umayalpuram Kodanda Rama Iyer, Palani Subramania Pillai, Vilvadri Iyer

chapters.name: Musical Forms and Terms (Class XII)
topics: Arudi, eduppu, gati bheda, anuloma, pratiloma, tisram, trikalam, theka, shadangas

chapters.name: Technical Terms (Class XII)
topics: Vilamba, madhya, druta, atitam, anagatam, pharan, kalapramanam, ghumki, konnakkol, choru, varu, toppi

chapters.name: Percussion Instruments (Class XII)
topics: Classification of percussion instruments; history of the chosen instrument
Morsing, tabla, chenda, edakka, gettu vadyam

chapters.name: Mohra, Korvai and Gumki (Class XII)
topics: Mohra and korvai for Khanda jati Ata and Triputa talas

chapters.name: Tani Avartanam and Accompaniment (Class XII)
topics: Tani avartanam in Misra and Khanda Chapu
